scenarios.criterion: Every registerElement call in lib/site/ locates its element with a [data-testid="..."] locator or a role-based locator, and the Vue component renders that test id.
scenarios.name: Every registered page element resolves through a stable data-testid or role locator
given: A Saturday page object in lib/site/ registers an element via registerElement
The Vue component that element targets is rendered
when: Each registerElement call's locator string is inspected against the rendered component's markup
then: The locator is either a [data-testid="..."] attribute selector or a role-based locator
The Vue component renders an element carrying that exact test id (or exposing that exact role)

scenarios.criterion: CartPage's complete-transaction button is located by data-testid="complete-transaction-btn".
scenarios.name: The complete-transaction button is found by a dedicated, literal test id
then: CartView.vue's button element carries data-testid="complete-transaction-btn" (not checkout-btn, and not a text- or role-based guess)

scenarios.criterion: No locator in lib/site/ uses has-text, :text, a CSS nth- pseudo-selector, or a selector string built from element nesting.
scenarios.name: No locator in the site layer depends on visible text, CSS position, or DOM nesting
given: The full set of locator strings used anywhere under lib/site/
when: Each locator string is scanned for has-text(, :text(, a CSS :nth- pseudo-class, or a descendant-combinator (nested) selector such as [data-testid="item-card"] a
then: Zero locator strings in lib/site/ contain has-text(, :text(, or a :nth- pseudo-class
Zero locator strings in lib/site/ combine a parent selector with a nested element via a descendant combinator
HomePage.ts's clickFirstProductDetails() locates its target through a flat [data-testid="item-name"] locator instead of [data-testid="item-card"] a

scenarios.criterion: Every scenario that passed before this change passes after it, with no .feature file or assertion changed.
scenarios.name: The existing behavior-verification suites are unaffected by the locator cleanup
given: The full existing Playwright and Cucumber suites pass before this change
when: The same suites are run again after the locator changes land, with no .feature file and no assertion edited
then: Every scenario that passed before still passes
No .feature file differs from before the change
No assertion in any test file differs from before the change

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line is covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths changes except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/golden-test-ids/.
scenarios.name: The change stays small, verifiable, and inside its declared scope
given: The complete set of source and test edits made to satisfy this change
when: Each new or changed function is measured for cyclomatic complexity
Each changed line is checked for a covering test, and that test is checked for a path to failure
The full list of changed files is compared against scope.paths
then: Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
Every changed line is covered by a test that fails if the fix is reverted
No file outside apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/**, apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/**, or docs/** changes, other than this run's delivery record under docs/features/golden-test-ids/
